Why this differed from the emails

The live tab, the emailed report and the emailed animation were three separate pipelines: different node subsets (779 / 194 / 474), different layouts (imported / inherited / Toolkit frames) and different colour algorithms (degree quintile / TF-IDF clusters / spectral clusters). Nothing was shared, so nothing matched. This snapshot removes the divergence: it records the server as the single source of truth.
